_comment: Pitch-deck attacker/proposer pair (prompts/pitch-deck-attacker.md, prompts/pitch-deck-proposer.md). Reuses the generic vibe-app pairing mode. Claude proposes, Gemini attacks, both via OpenRouter (one OPENROUTER_API_KEY). The pair is deliberately cross-vendor: this mode has a panel of ONE, so there is no second reviewer to catch a same-family attacker's blind spots. Gemini takes the attacker seat because this persona reads a deck as a whole document — narrative coherence across slides, claims that could be read two ways — which is structure-over-a-long-artifact rather than deep inference. Pass --tier to override both. Run: `node orchestrate.mjs --config agents.pitchdeck.json --task "..."` (or --file). Converges when the attacker's strongest standing finding is at/below --floor (default LOW).
